categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Nedfon Air System Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, research and development, production, and sales of indoor ventilation system products. Its main product lines include fresh air systems and air curtain machines, covering hundreds of series and thousands of models suitable for residential, municipal infrastructure, commercial, and industrial applications. The company also develops related products such as industrial and household dehumidifiers and humidifiers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in motor design, impeller and flow channel optimization, and control systems to enhance product performance. It employs manufacturing methods including laser cutting and flexible production lines to improve efficiency and precision. The company emphasizes energy-saving features such as heat recovery in fresh air systems and integrates intelligent, customized, and integrated ventilation solutions. It also utilizes product lifecycle management (PLM) systems and collaborates with top universities for R&D.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include real estate developers, construction and installation companies, industrial and commercial enterprises, and end-users in residential, commercial, healthcare, education, transportation hubs, and hospitality sectors. The company serves both domestic markets across major Chinese regions and overseas markets primarily in Southeast Asia. Sales channels include domestic distributors, direct sales, e-commerce platforms, and ODM for international clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with sales coverage across all major regions including East China, South China, North China, Central China, Southwest, Northwest, and Northeast. It has expanding overseas sales focused on Southeast Asian countries such as Thailand, Korea, Vietnam, the Philippines, and Saudi Arabia. Production facilities are located in Guangdong, Jiangsu, and Henan provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Nedfon Air System Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling indoor ventilation products. It procures raw materials and components such as steel, plastics, copper wires, electronic parts, and motors from suppliers, and sells finished products through distributors and direct channels to end customers. The company also established a supply chain management subsidiary to optimize procurement and logistics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to expand product categories, develop new application scenarios, improve product structures, and adopt new materials. It focuses on intelligent, customized, and integrated ventilation solutions. Key R&D projects include low-noise DC fans, modular air conditioning units, and specialized air curtain machines. The company actively participates in industry standard formulation and collaborates with universities to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of fresh air systems, air curtain machines, and related ventilation products. Sales are conducted via domestic distributors (majority), direct sales to large customers, e-commerce platforms, and ODM arrangements for overseas markets. The company also earns investment income from financial products, but the core business revenue is product-based.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both domestic and foreign ventilation system manufacturers. Major foreign competitors include Japanese brands like Panasonic, which dominate the high-end market segment. Domestic competition includes specialized ventilation manufacturers and large home appliance brands such as Midea. Nedfon is recognized as a leading domestic brand with strong R&D capabilities, broad product lines, and a significant market share in fresh air systems and air curtain machines, holding a top position in the latter.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 601.6 million, a 5.52% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 105 million, up 9.14%. Total assets reached RMB 1.27 billion, growing 13.54%, with shareholders' equity of RMB 876 million. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory with continuous expansion of production capacity and sales channels.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nedfon emphasizes improving indoor air quality and building energy efficiency through intelligent, customized, and integrated ventilation solutions. Its products feature advanced filtration, heat recovery, low noise, and energy-saving technologies. The company offers comprehensive system solutions supported by digital cloud design services, enhancing customer experience and installation effectiveness. Its strong R&D, extensive product range, and recognized brand reputation differentiate it in a fragmented market.
